findings.body:
This line tells readers to see `CONTRIBUTING`, but the repo has no `CONTRIBUTING` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` (or other CONTRIBUTING path) — only `README.md` and `poetry.lock` exist. Anyone following the new pointer hits a dead end.

Add the contributing doc (or point at an existing path), and prefer a real Markdown link once the target exists:

```suggestion
See [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md).
```

summary:
## Verdict

Docs-only intent is undercut by a broken CONTRIBUTING pointer and an unrelated lockfile pin change.

## Notes

`README.md` now says `See CONTRIBUTING.` but the repository only contains `README.md` and `poetry.lock` — there is no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or equivalent path for readers to open. The added line is also plain text, so even after a CONTRIBUTING file lands it still would not be a clickable Markdown link.

`poetry.lock` is in this PR (omitted from inline review as a lockfile) and moves the `pyyaml` pin from `6.0.2` to `5.3.1`. That is a dependency downgrade with no matching manifest/docs rationale in a PR titled as a README touch-up. Confirm it was intentional before merge; if it was accidental lock churn, drop it from the PR.

No repository instruction files (`AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / review guides) were present to apply project-specific rules.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
